finding: V2 reconstructs a via guard from track guards that already have their own asymmetric track cutout. Its 180-degree rejection at the existing ground via is not an intrinsic component-placement collision. A rigid native-via-guard rotation does not create that collision. This does not validate rotation of the complete block, tracks, pad connections, fixed cutouts or reference copper. No native rules were edited.
